title: Elijah Prays for Rain on Carmel
description: After defeating the prophets of Baal, Elijah earnestly prays for rain on top of Mount Carmel. The servant is sent seven times to look toward the sea, and on the seventh time a small cloud rises, followed by heavy rain that ends the long drought.
